import cv2

def enhance_image(img):
    lab = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2LAB)
    l, a, b = cv2.split(lab)
    clahe = cv2.createCLAHE(clipLimit=3.0, tileGridSize=(8,8))
    cl = clahe.apply(l)
    limg = cv2.merge((cl,a,b))
    final = cv2.cvtColor(limg, cv2.COLOR_LAB2BGR)
    return final

# Enhance and save
enhanced_header = enhance_image(cv2.imread('crop_header.png'))
enhanced_items = enhance_image(cv2.imread('crop_items.png'))
enhanced_tax = enhance_image(cv2.imread('crop_tax.png'))

cv2.imwrite('enhanced_header.png', enhanced_header)
